analytics.description: Umami, cookieless page counts (docs/accounts.md): `umamiScript` and `umamiWebsiteId` load it on every page; `publicDashboard` is the open dashboard linked from the site.

crawl.description: The platform crawler (scripts/crawl, npm run crawl) for Shopify and WooCommerce catalogs, and the bot's identity for every request (`userAgent`; `botNames`: the names a robots.txt may address it by). `concurrency` shops at once, at most `platformConcurrency` per platform, requests `delayMs` apart per shop (more if robots.txt asks; a shop asking over `maxCrawlDelaySeconds` is marked slow). Per shop: at most `maxPages` catalog pages, `maxRequestsPerShop` requests and `maxMinutesPerShop`; the whole run stops at `maxTotalMinutes` and saves; failed shops are retried once, `retryPassConcurrency` at a time. `timeoutMs`: per request. `inStockOnly`: skip sold-out products. `shards`: the crawl data release files.

products.description: Which products are records (scripts/lib, the crawlers and the index): a title or type matching `include` and not `exclude`. A shop whose sampled catalog has under `minShopMusicRatio` records is marked not-music; under `strictBelowRatio`, its products must match `include` to count.

seo.description: Static pages for search engines (scripts/index/site-data.js, src/pages): an artist gets a page with at least `artistMinRecords` records in `artistMinShops` shops, for at most `artistMaxPages` artists and `artistMaxRecordsPerPage` records each, `artistLdOffers` of them in its structured data; a shop page shows its `shopLatestRecords` newest.

search.description: The search index and search box: `docsPerChunk` records per index file (scripts/index); `maxArtists` artists in public/search/artists.json for suggestions. In the browser, results come as you type after `typeDelayMs`, from `typeMinChars` characters, and a typed search is kept in history once it settles `typeSettleMs`.

ledger.description: The offer ledger (scripts/ledger, docs/ledger.md): every offer seen, day by day. Events (new, restock, sold out, price drop) are kept `eventDays` days; a shop's first `newShopCrawls` crawls make no "new" events (its whole catalog would be new). Prices are logged `lowPriceDays` days; a price drop counts for `priceDropDays` days and up to `maxDrop` (a bigger drop is a pricing error). Gone offers stay searchable as sold out for `goneSearchDays` and in the ledger for `goneKeepDays`. A watch file lists at most `watchShops` shops per record.

newArrivals.description: New arrivals (scripts/ledger/new-arrivals.js, /new/ pages, Atom feeds): records new in the last `days` days, at most `pageItems` per page, `homeItems` on the home page, `stripItems` in a strip, `shopItems` on a shop page and `feedItems` per feed.

site.description: The site crawler (scripts/sources/site, npm run site) for shops on every other platform, in `shards` parallel jobs of at most `maxMinutes`. Per shop: `concurrency` shops at once, requests `delayMs` apart, `timeoutMs` and `maxBytes` per page, `pagesPerDay` pages a day (a `productLaneShare` of them for product pages), at most `maxMinutesPerShop`, `maxUrls` known URLs, `maxDepth` links from the home page. Sitemaps (read on `sitemapPlatforms`, `sitemapFiles` files every `sitemapDays` days) and `revisit` days per page kind decide what is read again; a record not seen for `recordMaxAgeDays` is dropped. A shop with under `minProductRatio` product pages in its first `evaluateAfterPages` is parked and re-checked after `reevaluateDays`; its reading method is probed again after `reprobeDays`, or when `readersVersion` goes up. `maxRetryAfterSeconds`: the longest Retry-After obeyed; `checkpointMinutes`: how often state is saved. `magentoPageSize`, `squareOnlinePageSize`: API page sizes. `commonCrawl`: URLs seeded from the `latest` Common Crawl indexes (or `crawls`), every `refreshDays`, at most `maxBlocksPerShop` index blocks per shop, `delayMs` apart, for `maxMinutes`.

manifest.description: The web app manifest (manifest.webmanifest): installed app name, display mode, colours and icon.

rates.description: Exchange rates (scripts/rates, npm run rates): the European Central Bank daily reference rates at `url`, saved to data/rates.json for "Prices in" and the quality checks.

dig.description: The Dig crates (public/dig.json): records new, back in stock or cheaper in the last `days` days, at most `perCrate` each; a price drop counts from `dropMin` to `dropMax` (share of the old price; bigger drops are pricing errors).

quality.description: Data-quality checks of npm run index (scripts/quality): a record priced under `minEur` or over `maxEur` (converted to euros with data/rates.json) has its price removed; a shop with at least `shopMinRecords` priced records whose median price is under `shopMinMedianEur` or over `shopMaxMedianEur` has all its prices removed (wrong currency); titles matching `testTitle` (shop test listings) are left out. `samples`: examples per reason in generated/quality-report.json.

health.description: Daily health report (scripts/health, run by Deploy): today's build against the last build of an earlier day. Degraded when records drop by more than `recordsDropMax` (share) or searchable shops by more than `shopsDropMax`, the site exceeds `siteMaxMB`, more than `crawlErrorMax` of the crawled shops failed, the crawl is older than `crawlMaxAgeHours`, or an end-to-end test failed. One GitHub issue labelled `label` is opened or updated, and closed once healthy. `keepDays` days of numbers are kept in the data release (health.json).
health.label: health

enrich.description: Artist profiles from open sources (scripts/enrich, docs/sources.md), run daily by the Enrich workflow. Each run reads the artists of the live site (/api/artists.json) and profiles at most `artistsPerRun` of them, for at most `maxMinutes`: new ones first, then the oldest after `refreshDays` (`retryNoneDays` for one not found). An artist is matched on MusicBrainz only through one of its records in stock (`titlesPerArtist` titles tried), never by name alone. Requests are one at a time per host, at least `paceMs` apart (MusicBrainz asks for one a second). Wikipedia summaries in `wikipediaLanguages`; `genres`: most-voted MusicBrainz genres kept; `imageWidth`: Wikimedia Commons thumbnail width. `leadChars`: the summary's first sentences shown up to this length, the rest under "Read more". `paceMs` also paces the social job (scripts/social): the relay, plc.directory and the Bluesky app view; any other host (a collector's account server) gets one request a second. It also paces Nominatim for npm run locate (scripts/discover/locate.js), which asks for one request a second.

social.description: The collectors feed (scripts/social, docs/feed.md), run daily by Refresh: accounts that published a list (com.lpepfinder.list, opt-in) found through the Bluesky `relay` (listReposByCollection), at most `maxCollectors`; each one's lists read from its own account. Out comes public/social.json: the collectors, how many want and have each record, the records wanted since the day before (kept `eventDays` days, at most `maxEvents`) and the `topWanted` most wanted.

check.description: How often shops are checked (scripts/check/plan.js): a full check (home page, robots.txt, platform probe, Bluesky) every `fullDays` days, the day after a failed crawl and when a shop's address changes; robots.txt alone on the days between, so an opt-out counts the next day. Dead shops are checked again after half the days they've been dead, at most every `deadMaxDays`.
